apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.38 — The group editor (Add loops / New group) now speaks the app’s pill language instead of a system checklist: members are wrapping pills like the loops page — accent fill and a tick when chosen, the loop’s range and current group kept as small text inside the pill, group candidates with their colour dot and count. The name field is a rounded panel field, and every rule (empty new group removes itself, Save arms the group) is unchanged.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
